common_issues: All ingredient names missing _raw suffix - blocker fix across batch
Salt completely absent from all 5 recipes - universal addition needed
Mustard oil tempering (paanch phoron, kalo jeera) missing from Bengali dishes - cultural inauthenticity
Vegan tag retained where traditional Bengali cooking uses ghee/mustard oil - applying canonical ingredient rule, dropping vegan where appropriate
Khichuri missing turmeric, ginger, ghee tempering - fundamentally incomplete recipe
Niramish aloor dum missing core spices (cumin, ginger, turmeric, asafoetida) - blocker for dish authenticity
Several recipes are too ingredient-sparse to constitute real meals (just potato + chilli + water)
Per-serving calorie counts severely under-target for breakfast (250-500 kcal range)

issues.problem: potato and green chilli missing _raw suffix
Authentic chachchari requires mustard oil tempering with panch phoron (or at minimum kalonji/nigella substitute); recipe is just boiled potato in water which is not chachchari
issues.suggested_fix: Add mustard_oil_raw 10g, cumin_raw 1g, fenugreek_seeds_raw 0.5g, fennel_seeds_raw 0.5g, turmeric_powder_raw 1g

issues.problem: No salt - universal addition needed
300g potato + chilli for 2 servings ≈ 115 kcal/serving, far below breakfast 250-500 target
issues.suggested_fix: Oil + spice additions raise it; still on low end but acceptable as side dish style

issues.problem: Instructions describe boiled potatoes, not Bengali chachchari technique (tempering + dry stir-fry)
issues.suggested_fix: Rewrite to start with mustard oil heating, panch phoron crackling, then potatoes

issues.problem: All four ingredients missing _raw suffix

Niramish aloor dum requires asafoetida, ginger, cumin, turmeric, red chilli powder, bay leaf, mustard oil/ghee - none present. The 'niramish' (no onion/garlic) version specifically depends on these spices for flavour
issues.suggested_fix: Add mustard_oil_raw 10g, asafoetida_raw 0.5g, ginger_raw 8g, cumin_raw 1g, bay_leaf_raw 0.3g, turmeric_powder_raw 1g, red_chilli_powder_raw 1g, garam_masala_raw 0.5g

issues.problem: No salt
≈ 80 kcal/serving without oil/spices
issues.suggested_fix: Mustard oil addition raises to ≈ 130 kcal; still light but acceptable for breakfast side

issues.problem: Adding mustard oil keeps vegan valid; jain tag could be added since niramish excludes onion/garlic
issues.suggested_fix: Add 'jain' to diet_tags (note: still contains potato so jain may be debated - leave off to be safe)

issues.problem: potato and green chilli missing _raw suffix
Chorchori is a Bengali tempered vegetable dish; mustard oil + panch phoron (or nigella seeds) is essential. Plain boiled potato in water is not chorchori
issues.suggested_fix: Add mustard_oil_raw 10g, cumin_raw 1g, fennel_seeds_raw 0.5g, fenugreek_seeds_raw 0.5g, turmeric_powder_raw 1g

issues.problem: No salt
250g potato shown as '1.6 cup' is awkward and inconsistent with other recipes using 'piece' for whole potatoes
Method describes water-poaching, not the dry-sauté tempering technique chorchori demands
issues.suggested_fix: Rewrite with mustard oil heating, spice tempering, then potato strips stir-fried

issues.problem: basmati rice, moong dal, potato missing _raw suffix

Bhaja moong dal khichuri without turmeric, ginger, bay leaf, cumin, green cardamom, cloves, cinnamon, and ghee tempering is not khichuri - it is plain rice-dal porridge. Bengali bhuni khichuri specifically uses ghee
issues.suggested_fix: Add ghee_raw 15g, turmeric_powder_raw 2g, ginger_raw 8g, cumin_raw 1g, bay_leaf_raw 0.5g, green_cardamom_raw 0.5g, cloves_raw 0.3g, cinnamon_raw 0.5g, dried_red_chilli_raw 1g, green_chilli_raw 5g

issues.problem: No salt
Authentic khichuri uses ghee; per protocol, use canonical ingredient and drop vegan/dairy_free tags
issues.suggested_fix: Remove 'vegan' and 'dairy_free' from diet_tags; allergen_tags add 'dairy'

issues.problem: Currently 90g rice + 50g dal + 150g potato for 2 ≈ 380 kcal/serving without fat; ghee addition brings to ≈ 450 kcal, fits breakfast band well
issues.suggested_fix: No change needed once ghee added

issues.problem: All four ingredients missing _raw suffix

Recipe contains onion - jain tag would not apply (already not listed, fine); vegan retained correctly with mustard oil
issues.suggested_fix: No tag change needed; vegan/dairy_free preserved with mustard oil (not ghee here, as aloo bhate is traditionally mustard oil)

issues.problem: 120g rice + 150g potato + oil for 2 ≈ 380 kcal/serving - fits breakfast range
